description.en: Scaffold for an agent-moderated group conversation: an hourly assess tick checks the recorded facilitation progress against the machine-checkable definition of done (bounded to 24 rounds), nudges a stalled group, hands a met DoD to the initiator for confirmation, and reports result or failure. The scaffold is deterministic; only the moderation itself is agentic.
description.de: Gerüst für eine agentenmoderierte Gruppenkonversation: Ein stündlicher Assess-Tick prüft den protokollierten Fortschritt gegen die maschinell prüfbare Definition-of-Done (begrenzt auf 24 Runden), stupst eine stockende Gruppe an, legt eine erfüllte DoD dem Initiator zur Bestätigung vor und berichtet Ergebnis oder Fehlschlag. Das Gerüst ist deterministisch; nur die Moderation selbst ist agentisch.

human.message: The facilitation toward "{{ctx.goal}}" has concluded. Outcome summary: {{steps.moderate.text}}. Please approve the result.

steps.prompt: The initiator approved the facilitation outcome for the goal {{ctx.goal}}. Produce the final report (the confirmed result, the path the group took, the insights that emerged) and DELIVER it by calling facilitation_report with kind "final". FORMAT (hard rules for the report text): write compact Teams-flavoured Markdown in the conversation's language. Use '**bold**' mini-headings and '-' bullet lists ONLY. NEVER draw ASCII dividers, lines of dashes/underscores, box characters or ALL-CAPS banner headings — they render as an unreadable wall of text in chat. Structure: one bold title line with an outcome emoji (✅ confirmed / ❌ no result), then at most four short sections — result, state reached, why there is no result (only in the failure case), next steps — with the section headings written in the conversation's language (German example: '**Ergebnis**', '**Erreichter Stand**', '**Woran es lag**', '**Nächste Schritte**'), each 1-5 bullets, each bullet one line. Total length under 150 words. No preamble, no sign-off.

The facilitation for the goal {{ctx.goal}} ended without a confirmed result (deadline, exhausted rounds, or no confirmation). Produce an honest failure report (state reached, why no confirmed result exists, what the group would need to continue) and DELIVER it by calling facilitation_report with kind "final". FORMAT (hard rules for the report text): write compact Teams-flavoured Markdown in the conversation's language. Use '**bold**' mini-headings and '-' bullet lists ONLY. NEVER draw ASCII dividers, lines of dashes/underscores, box characters or ALL-CAPS banner headings — they render as an unreadable wall of text in chat. Structure: one bold title line with an outcome emoji (✅ confirmed / ❌ no result), then at most four short sections — result, state reached, why there is no result (only in the failure case), next steps — with the section headings written in the conversation's language (German example: '**Ergebnis**', '**Erreichter Stand**', '**Woran es lag**', '**Nächste Schritte**'), each 1-5 bullets, each bullet one line. Total length under 150 words. No preamble, no sign-off.

description.en: Agent that assesses progress on each tick, nudges the group, and writes the reports.
description.de: Agent, der pro Tick den Fortschritt bewertet, die Gruppe anstupst und die Berichte schreibt.

description.en: Role that commissioned the facilitation and confirms the outcome.
description.de: Rolle, die die Moderation beauftragt hat und das Ergebnis bestätigt.

description.en: Channel used to reach the initiator for confirmation and reporting.
